*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form X_CALL_VIEWMAINTENANCE                                   *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* external call of view maintenance                                   *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* --> XCV_USE_LCL_TBL:  'X' Datencontainer XCV_TOTAL und XCV_EXTRACT
*                       sind nicht struktueriert und nicht vom Typ X
*                       => Daten müssen in lokale Container umgesetzt
*                       werden.
* --> XCV_IMP_SPECMODE: 'P' Profilimport/
*                       'T' Testmodus Import/'F' Forcemodus Import /
*                       'B' T + F Import
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM x_call_viewmaintenance USING
                                value(xcv_use_lcl_tbl) LIKE tvdir-flag
                                value(xcv_import) LIKE tvdir-flag
                                xcv_corrnbr LIKE e070-trkorr
                                value(xcv_fcode) TYPE vimty_tcode
                                value(xcv_action) LIKE tvdir-flag
                                value(xcv_name) TYPE vimty_tablename
                                value(xcv_tot_name) TYPE c
                                value(xcv_ext_name) TYPE c
                                value(xcv_upgr_dest) LIKE rfcdes-rfcdest
                                value(xcv_upgr_clnt) LIKE sy-mandt
                                xcv_upd_requ LIKE tvdir-flag
                                xcv_e071k TYPE table
                                xcv_dba_sel TYPE table
                                xcv_dpl_sel TYPE table
                                xcv_excufc TYPE table
                                xcv_extract TYPE table
                                xcv_total TYPE table
                                xcv_header TYPE table
                                xcv_namtab TYPE table
                                xcv_last_command TYPE vimty_tcode
                                xcv_last_act_entry LIKE sy-tabix
                                xcv_results LIKE vimmodres
                                xcv_imp_results TYPE slctr_tables_keys
                                value(xcv_imp_specmode) LIKE tvdir-flag
                                value(xcv_cmp_slcnds) LIKE tvdir-flag.

  DATA: xcv_return TYPE i, xcv_i_fcode TYPE vimty_tcode,                   "#EC NEEDED
        line_name(30) TYPE c, length TYPE i, tabtype TYPE ob_typ,
        header_wa_loc TYPE vimdesc,
        BEGIN OF tabline,
          line(4096) TYPE c,
        END OF tabline.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <total> TYPE table, <extract> TYPE table,
                 <tabline> TYPE ANY, <tabline_x> TYPE x,
                 <tabline2> TYPE ANY, <tabline2_x> TYPE x,
                 <header> TYPE vimdesc.
  LOCAL: vim_import_mode_active, vim_no_dialog, vim_import_testmode,
         vim_import_forcemode.          "SW  wg. Rekurs. im Cluster

  vim_no_dialog = xcv_import. TRANSLATE vim_no_dialog USING 'H DX'.
  IF xcv_imp_specmode = 'P'.           "Profilimp
    vim_import_profile = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
  vim_import_testmode = xcv_imp_specmode.
  TRANSLATE vim_import_testmode USING 'TXBXF P '.
  vim_import_forcemode = xcv_imp_specmode.
  TRANSLATE vim_import_forcemode USING 'T BXFXP '.
  IF xcv_use_lcl_tbl NE space.
    ASSIGN: (xcv_tot_name) TO <total>, (xcv_ext_name) TO <extract>.
    IF xcv_use_lcl_tbl NE 'L'.         "use not _only_ local tables
      READ TABLE xcv_header ASSIGNING <header> CASTING INDEX 1.
      IF <header>-bastab NE space AND <header>-texttbexst NE space.
        length = <header>-after_tabc + <header>-aft_txttbc
                 + 3 * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
      ELSE.
        length = <header>-after_tabc
                 + 2 * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
      ENDIF.
      SEARCH xcv_tot_name FOR '[' IN CHARACTER MODE.
      MOVE xcv_tot_name(sy-fdpos) TO line_name.
      ASSIGN: (line_name) TO <tabline2>,
              <tabline2> TO <tabline2_x> CASTING.
      REFRESH: <total>, <extract>.
      LOOP AT xcv_total ASSIGNING <tabline>.
        ASSIGN <tabline> TO <tabline_x> CASTING.
        MOVE <tabline_x> TO <tabline2_x>(length).
        APPEND <tabline2> TO <total>.
      ENDLOOP.
      LOOP AT xcv_extract ASSIGNING <tabline>.
        ASSIGN <tabline> TO <tabline_x> CASTING.
        MOVE <tabline_x> TO <tabline2_x>(length).
        APPEND <tabline2> TO <extract>.
      ENDLOOP.
*      <total> = xcv_total. <extract> = xcv_extract.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    ASSIGN: xcv_total TO <total>, xcv_extract TO <extract>.
  ENDIF.
  vim_import_mode_active = xcv_import. xcv_i_fcode = xcv_fcode.
  IF xcv_import NE space AND xcv_fcode NE 'SAVE'.
  ELSEIF xcv_import NE space AND xcv_fcode EQ 'SAVE'.       "SW
    imp_results[] = xcv_imp_results[].                      "SW
  ELSEIF xcv_fcode EQ 'INS' OR xcv_fcode EQ 'DEL' OR
         xcv_fcode EQ 'UPD' OR xcv_fcode EQ 'SHOW'.
    vim_single_entry_function = xcv_fcode. xcv_i_fcode = 'EDIT'.
  ENDIF.
  IF xcv_import EQ 'D' AND xcv_fcode EQ 'SAVE'.
    vim_import_no_message = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE_LOW_LEVEL'
    EXPORTING
      corr_number                 = xcv_corrnbr
      fcode                       = xcv_i_fcode
      view_action                 = xcv_action
      view_name                   = xcv_name
      rfc_destination_for_upgrade = xcv_upgr_dest
      client_for_upgrade          = xcv_upgr_clnt
      complex_selconds_used       = xcv_cmp_slcnds
    IMPORTING
      last_act_entry              = xcv_last_act_entry
      ucomm                       = xcv_last_command
      update_required             = xcv_upd_requ
      corr_number                 = xcv_corrnbr
    TABLES
      corr_keytab                 = xcv_e071k
      dba_sellist                 = xcv_dba_sel
      dpl_sellist                 = xcv_dpl_sel
      excl_cua_funct              = xcv_excufc
      extract                     = <extract>
      total                       = <total>
      x_header                    = xcv_header
      x_namtab                    = xcv_namtab
    EXCEPTIONS
      function_not_found          = 1
      missing_corr_number         = 2
      no_value_for_subset_ident   = 3
      saving_correction_failed    = 4.
*  IF xcv_import NE space AND
*     ( sy-subrc NE 0 OR
*       xcv_fcode EQ save AND <status>-upd_flag NE space ).
* "HCG BC-Set: sy-subrc NE 0 -> always error message in log
  IF ( xcv_import NE space OR vim_import_profile NE space ) AND
     ( sy-subrc NE 0 OR
       xcv_fcode EQ save AND <status>-upd_flag NE space ).
    IF sy-msgid NE space.
      vim_import_no_message = 'X'.
      IF vim_import_profile = 'X'.
        READ TABLE xcv_header INTO header_wa_loc INDEX 1.
        IF header_wa_loc-bastab EQ space.
          tabtype = 'V'.
        ELSE.
          tabtype = 'S'.
        ENDIF.
        PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING sy-msgid 'I' 'E' sy-msgno
                        sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 tabtype.
      ELSE.
        PERFORM vim_process_message USING sy-msgid 'I' 'E' sy-msgno
                       sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR vim_import_no_message.
    ENDIF.
*   IF XCV_IMPORT NE SPACE.
    LOOP AT imp_results.
      IF imp_results-import-inserted NE 0.
        imp_results-import-errors = imp_results-import-inserted.
        CLEAR imp_results-import-inserted.
      ELSEIF imp_results-import-updated NE 0.
        imp_results-import-errors = imp_results-import-updated.
        CLEAR imp_results-import-updated.
      ELSEIF imp_results-import-deleted NE 0.
        imp_results-import-errors = imp_results-import-deleted.
        CLEAR imp_results-import-deleted.
      ENDIF.
      MODIFY imp_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ELSEIF xcv_import EQ space AND xcv_fcode EQ 'READ' AND
         sy-subrc NE 0.                "probably called by VIEW_GET_DATA
    IF sy-subrc EQ 2. "probably individual authority check failed
      MESSAGE i053(sv) RAISING no_authority.
    ELSE.                              "other error
      MESSAGE i037(sv) WITH view_name RAISING no_viewmaint_tool.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  IF xcv_fcode EQ 'EXED' OR xcv_fcode EQ 'DEL'.
    xcv_results = vim_results_of_ext_mod.
  ELSEIF xcv_fcode EQ read.
    DESCRIBE TABLE <total> LINES xcv_results-nbr_of_upd.
  ELSEIF xcv_fcode EQ save AND xcv_import EQ 'D'.
    CLEAR vim_import_no_message.
  ENDIF.
  IF xcv_use_lcl_tbl NE space AND xcv_use_lcl_tbl NE 'L'.
    REFRESH: xcv_total, xcv_extract.
    ASSIGN: tabline TO <tabline2_x> CASTING.
    LOOP AT <total> ASSIGNING <tabline>.
      ASSIGN <tabline> TO <tabline_x> CASTING.
      MOVE <tabline_x> TO <tabline2_x>(length).
      APPEND tabline TO xcv_total.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT <extract> ASSIGNING <tabline>.
      ASSIGN <tabline> TO <tabline_x> CASTING.
      MOVE <tabline_x> TO <tabline2_x>(length).
      APPEND tabline TO xcv_extract.
    ENDLOOP.
*    MOVE: <total> TO xcv_total, <extract> TO xcv_extract.
  ENDIF.
  CLEAR vim_single_entry_function.                          "SW
  IF xcv_import NE space.
    xcv_imp_results = imp_results[].
    REFRESH imp_results.                                    "SW
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               "x_call_viewmaintenance

FORM fill_enqueue_table USING value(fet_table) value(fet_fordir).
  DATA: e TYPE c VALUE 'E', fieldcount TYPE i, rofldcount TYPE i,
        i TYPE c VALUE 'I',
        n TYPE c VALUE 'N',
        fodir TYPE c.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* fill enqueue_table for current table                                 *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
  IF dd26v_tab-fordir EQ i AND fet_fordir EQ e.
    MOVE fet_fordir TO fodir.
  ELSE.
    MOVE dd26v_tab-fordir TO fodir.
  ENDIF.
  CASE fodir.
    WHEN i.                                                 "import
      PERFORM set_enqueue_mode USING fet_table enqueue_table-enqmode.
    WHEN e.                                                 "export
      MOVE n TO enqueue_table-enqmode. "Tab is readonly -> no enqueue
    WHEN space.                                             "roottab
      roottab = dd26v_tab-tabname.
      PERFORM set_enqueue_mode USING roottab enqueue_table-enqmode.
  ENDCASE.
  READ TABLE dd02l_tab WITH KEY fet_table BINARY SEARCH.
  IF dd02l_tab-clidep EQ 'K'.
    RAISE client_reference.
  ENDIF.
  MOVE: dd02l_tab-clidep TO enqueue_table-clidep,
        fet_table        TO enqueue_table-tabname.
  APPEND enqueue_table.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* now following tables in foreign key graph                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
  LOOP AT dd26v_tab WHERE fortabname EQ fet_table.
    CHECK dd26v_tab-fordir NE space.  "ignore rootab entry
    PERFORM fill_enqueue_table USING dd26v_tab-tabname fodir.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "fill_enqueue_table

****************************************
FORM enqueue_tab USING value(table) value(generic_key)
                       value(mode) value(action).
  TABLES: tfdir.
  DATA: f_name LIKE tfdir-funcname.
  CASE action.
    WHEN 'E'.                             "lock table.
      CASE mode.
        WHEN 'E'. f_name = 'ENQUEUE_E_TABLEE'. "exclusive lock
        WHEN 'S'. f_name = 'ENQUEUE_E_TABLES'. "shared lock
        WHEN OTHERS. RAISE invalid_enqueue_mode.
      ENDCASE.
    WHEN 'D'.                             "dequeueu table
      CASE mode.
        WHEN 'E'. f_name = 'DEQUEUE_E_TABLEE'. "exclusive lock
        WHEN 'S'. f_name = 'DEQUEUE_E_TABLES'. "shared lock
        WHEN OTHERS. RAISE invalid_enqueue_mode.
      ENDCASE.
    WHEN OTHERS. RAISE invalid_action.
  ENDCASE.
  CALL FUNCTION f_name
    EXPORTING
      tabname        = table
      varkey         = generic_key
    EXCEPTIONS
      foreign_lock   = 1
      system_failure = 2.
ENDFORM.                    "enqueue_tab

FORM fill_keyfields USING value(fk_view) TYPE tabname
                          p_viewfields TYPE ddfields.
  DATA: fk_dd05s TYPE TABLE OF dd05s INITIAL SIZE 10,
        w_dd05s TYPE dd05s,
        fk_ptnam      LIKE dd05s-tabname,
        fk_ftnam      LIKE dd05s-tabname,
        fk_x031l      LIKE x031l,
        fk_x031l_tab  LIKE x031l OCCURS 10,
        fk_x030l1     LIKE x030l,
        fk_x031l_tab1 LIKE x031l OCCURS 10,
        fk_keyfields  LIKE keyfields,
        fk_roottab    LIKE dd02l-tabname.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <viewfields> TYPE dfies.

  REFRESH keyfields.
  IF tvdir-bastab EQ space.
* view
***********************************************************************
    LOOP AT dd26v_tab.
      keyfields-tabname = dd26v_tab-tabname.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_NAMETAB_GET'
        EXPORTING
          tabname   = dd26v_tab-tabname
        TABLES
          x031l_tab = fk_x031l_tab[].
      IF dd26v_tab-fordir EQ space.                         "roottab
        fk_roottab = dd26v_tab-tabname.
        LOOP AT dd27p_tab WHERE tabname EQ dd26v_tab-tabname
                            AND keyflag NE space.
          LOOP AT fk_x031l_tab INTO fk_x031l
                               WHERE fieldname EQ dd27p_tab-fieldname.
            keyfields-position = fk_x031l-position.
            keyfields-datatype = fk_x031l-dtyp.
            keyfields-offset = fk_x031l-offset.
            keyfields-intlen = fk_x031l-dblength.
            EXIT.
          ENDLOOP.
          keyfields-keyfield = dd27p_tab-fieldname.
          keyfields-viewfield = dd27p_tab-viewfield.
          APPEND keyfields.
        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.                                                 "sektab
        IF dd26v_tab-fordir EQ 'I'.
          fk_ftnam = dd26v_tab-tabname. fk_ptnam = dd26v_tab-fortabname.
        ELSE.
          fk_ftnam = dd26v_tab-fortabname. fk_ptnam = dd26v_tab-tabname.
        ENDIF.
        LOOP AT dd27p_tab WHERE tabname EQ dd26v_tab-tabname
                            AND keyflag NE space.
          LOOP AT fk_x031l_tab INTO fk_x031l
                               WHERE fieldname EQ dd27p_tab-fieldname.
            keyfields-position = fk_x031l-position.
            keyfields-datatype = fk_x031l-dtyp.
            keyfields-offset = fk_x031l-offset.
            keyfields-intlen = fk_x031l-dblength.
            EXIT.
          ENDLOOP.
          keyfields-keyfield = dd27p_tab-fieldname.
          keyfields-viewfield = dd27p_tab-viewfield.
          APPEND keyfields.
* if there are keyfields of sectab in view they may be related to not
* contained keyfields of roottab -> check it
          CHECK fk_ptnam EQ fk_roottab. "checktable is roottab
          fk_keyfields-tabname = roottab.
          SELECT * FROM dd05s INTO TABLE fk_dd05s
                              WHERE tabname EQ fk_ftnam
                                AND fieldname EQ dd26v_tab-forfield.
          IMPORT NAMETAB fk_x030l1 fk_x031l_tab1 ID roottab.
          LOOP AT fk_dd05s INTO w_dd05s
                           WHERE fortable EQ dd26v_tab-tabname
                             AND forkey   EQ keyfields-keyfield.
            LOOP AT fk_x031l_tab1 INTO fk_x031l
                                 WHERE position EQ w_dd05s-primpos.
              fk_keyfields-position = fk_x031l-position.
              fk_keyfields-datatype = fk_x031l-dtyp.
              fk_keyfields-offset = fk_x031l-offset.
              fk_keyfields-intlen = fk_x031l-dblength.
              fk_keyfields-keyfield = fk_x031l-fieldname.
              EXIT.
            ENDLOOP.
            fk_keyfields-viewfield = dd27p_tab-viewfield.
            READ TABLE keyfields WITH KEY fk_keyfields
                                 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
            IF sy-subrc NE 0.
              APPEND fk_keyfields TO keyfields.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDLOOP.
* may be not all keyfields of sektab are contained but some are.
        SELECT * FROM dd05s INTO TABLE fk_dd05s
                            WHERE tabname EQ fk_ftnam
                              AND fieldname EQ dd26v_tab-forfield.
        LOOP AT fk_dd05s INTO w_dd05s
                         WHERE fortable EQ dd26v_tab-tabname.
          READ TABLE keyfields WITH KEY tabname = keyfields-tabname
                                        keyfield = w_dd05s-forkey
                               TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
          CHECK sy-subrc NE 0.
          LOOP AT fk_x031l_tab INTO fk_x031l
                               WHERE fieldname EQ w_dd05s-forkey.
            keyfields-position = fk_x031l-position.
            keyfields-datatype = fk_x031l-dtyp.
            keyfields-offset = fk_x031l-offset.
            keyfields-intlen = fk_x031l-dblength.
            EXIT.
          ENDLOOP.
          keyfields-keyfield = w_dd05s-forkey.
          READ TABLE keyfields INTO fk_keyfields
                               WITH KEY tabname = fk_ptnam
                                        position = w_dd05s-primpos.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
            keyfields-viewfield = fk_keyfields-viewfield.
          ELSE.
            CLEAR keyfields-viewfield.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND keyfields.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ELSE.
* table
**********************************************************************
    keyfields-tabname = fk_view.
    LOOP AT p_viewfields ASSIGNING <viewfields>
     WHERE tabname EQ fk_view AND keyflag NE space.
      keyfields-position = <viewfields>-position.
      keyfields-datatype = <viewfields>-datatype.
      keyfields-offset = <viewfields>-offset.
      keyfields-intlen = <viewfields>-intlen.
      keyfields-keyfield = <viewfields>-fieldname.
      keyfields-viewfield = <viewfields>-fieldname.
      APPEND keyfields.
    ENDLOOP.
    READ TABLE state_tab WITH KEY name = fk_view BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND state_tab-texttbexst NE space.
      keyfields-tabname = state_tab-texttbname.
      LOOP AT p_viewfields ASSIGNING <viewfields>
       WHERE tabname EQ state_tab-texttbname AND keyflag NE space.
        keyfields-position = <viewfields>-position.
        keyfields-datatype = <viewfields>-datatype.
        keyfields-offset = <viewfields>-offset.
        keyfields-intlen = <viewfields>-intlen.
        keyfields-keyfield = <viewfields>-fieldname.
        LOOP AT dd05m_tab_txt WHERE fortable EQ state_tab-texttbname
                            AND forkey   EQ <viewfields>-fieldname.
          READ TABLE keyfields INTO fk_keyfields
           WITH KEY tabname = fk_view position = dd05m_tab_txt-primpos.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
            keyfields-viewfield = fk_keyfields-viewfield.
          ELSE.
            CLEAR keyfields-viewfield.
          ENDIF.
          EXIT.
        ENDLOOP.
        IF sy-subrc NE 0. CLEAR keyfields-viewfield. ENDIF.
        APPEND keyfields.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF. "sy-subrc eq 0 and state_tab-texttbexst ne space
  ENDIF. "tvdir-bastab eq space
  last_keyfields_view = fk_view.
ENDFORM. "fill_keyfields

****************************************
FORM fill_tabkey USING value(ft_tabname) LIKE dd02v-tabname
                       ft_tabkey LIKE rstable-varkey.
  DATA: not_converted         LIKE sy-subrc,
        ft_enqueue_pattern(2) TYPE c VALUE ' @',
        ft_max_keylength_char TYPE i,
        ft_max_keylength_byte TYPE i,
        ft_hf                 TYPE i,
        ft_hf1                TYPE i.

*field-symbols: <hf>, <hf_int>.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS:
    <x_src>       TYPE x,
    <x_dest>      TYPE x,
    <x_total_key> TYPE x.

  DESCRIBE FIELD ft_tabname LENGTH ft_hf IN CHARACTER MODE.
  ft_max_keylength_char = max_enq_arg_length - ft_hf.
  ft_max_keylength_byte =
    ft_max_keylength_char * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.

  ASSIGN ft_tabkey TO <x_total_key> CASTING.
* offsets and lengths are in bytes; therefore we need a 'container'
* which interprets offsets as bytes and not char like ft_tabkey would do

  CLEAR ft_tabkey.
  TRANSLATE ft_tabkey USING ft_enqueue_pattern.

  CHECK ft_tabname NE 'T000'.   "client table is not clientdependent !!
  LOOP AT keyfields WHERE tabname EQ ft_tabname.
    IF keyfields-datatype EQ 'CLNT' AND keyfields-position EQ 1.
      ASSIGN sy-mandt TO <x_src> CASTING.
      ASSIGN <x_total_key>+keyfields-offset(keyfields-intlen)
        TO <x_dest>.
      <x_dest> = <x_src>.
    ELSE.
      CHECK enqueue_range NE space.
      ft_hf = keyfields-offset + keyfields-intlen.
      ft_hf1 = ft_hf DIV ft_max_keylength_byte.
      ft_hf = keyfields-intlen -
              ft_hf1 * ( ft_hf MOD ft_max_keylength_byte ).
      IF keyfields-offset GE ft_max_keylength_byte OR ft_hf1 GT 1.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT sellist WHERE viewfield EQ keyfields-viewfield
                        AND ddic CO subset_marks.
        READ TABLE viewfields WITH KEY fieldname = keyfields-viewfield.
        CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
        i_sellist = sellist.
        PERFORM prepare_conversion USING viewfields-intlen
                                         viewfields-inttype
                                         viewfields-datatype
                                         viewfields-decimals
                                         viewfields-convexit space.
        IF sellist-converted EQ space.
          ASSIGN sellist-value(viewfields-outputlen) TO <cvalue>.
          PERFORM input_conversion USING space space <cvalue>
                                         viewfields-inttype
                                         viewfields-intlen
                                         viewfields-datatype
                                         viewfields-decimals
                                         viewfields-leng
                                         viewfields-sign 'A'
                                         space space space
                                         sellist-operator
                                         viewfields-lowercase
                                         viewfields-convexit
                                         not_converted.
          IF not_converted EQ 0.
            i_sellist-converted = 'X'. sellist = i_sellist.
            MODIFY sellist.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        ASSIGN <value> TO <x_src> CASTING. "make it hex and
        ASSIGN <x_src>(ft_hf) TO <x_src>.  "reduce to the correct length
        " can not be done in one step, because <value>(ft_hf) might
        " be interpreted as ft_hf characters
        ASSIGN <x_total_key>+keyfields-offset(ft_hf) TO <x_dest>.
        <x_dest> = <x_src>.
      ENDLOOP.                                              "at sellist
    ENDIF. "keyfields-datatype eq 'CLNT' and.....
  ENDLOOP. "at keyfields
ENDFORM. "fill_tabkey

****************************************
FORM set_enqueue_mode USING value(sem_table) LIKE dd27v-tabname
                            sem_enqmode TYPE c.
  DATA: fieldcount TYPE i, rofldcount TYPE i,
        r TYPE c VALUE 'R',
        e TYPE c VALUE 'E',
        n TYPE c VALUE 'N'.

  LOOP AT dd27p_tab WHERE tabname EQ sem_table.
    ADD 1 TO fieldcount.
*   CHECK dd27p_tab-rdonly EQ r."HCG Readonly changeable in background
*   ADD 1 TO rofldcount.        "HCG HW 720711
  ENDLOOP.
  IF fieldcount EQ rofldcount.
    MOVE n TO sem_enqmode. "Tab is readonly -> no enqueue
  ELSE.
    MOVE e TO sem_enqmode. " ---> exclusive mode
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    "set_enqueue_mode

************************************************************************
FORM build_mess_uname
  USING    pv_order TYPE trkorr
           pv_uname TYPE tr_as4user
  CHANGING pv_mess_uname TYPE symsgv.

  CONCATENATE pv_order ' (' pv_uname ')' INTO pv_mess_uname.

ENDFORM.                    "build_mess_uname

************************************************************************
*  Check, if it is allowed to create a new order                       *
************************************************************************
FORM check_create_new_task
  USING    ps_e070_tr TYPE e070
           pv_task_typ TYPE trfunction
  CHANGING pv_create_allowed TYPE trboolean.

  IF        ps_e070_tr-trstatus   =   treld
  OR (      ps_e070_tr-as4user    =   sy-uname

************************************************************************
*  check if user is member in the order                                *
************************************************************************
FORM check_order_for_append  USING cofa_order
                                     cofa_category
                                     cofa_cli_dep
                                     cofa_order_type
                                     cofa_task_type
                                     cofa_v_order
                                     cofa_v_task.
  DATA: w_found(1)       TYPE c,
        q_not_ok(1)      TYPE c,
        w_e070           LIKE e070,
        w_e070c          LIKE e070c,
        ls_order_strkorr LIKE e070.

  SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070
                  INTO w_e070
                  WHERE trkorr = cofa_order.
  IF   sy-subrc  =    0.
*every object category allowed when order category is syst**************
    IF   cofa_category = 'SYST'
    AND  w_e070-trfunction = tcor.
      q_not_ok            =    k_x.
    ENDIF.

*** client check *******************************************************
    IF   q_not_ok            =    space.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070c INTO w_e070c
                      WHERE trkorr = cofa_order.
      IF   cofa_cli_dep        ><   space
      AND  w_e070c-client      ><   sy-mandt.
        q_not_ok            =    k_x.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

*** check task-type / order_type ***************************************
    IF   q_not_ok  =    space.
      IF   w_e070-trfunction        CA   ordertype.
        IF ( cofa_order_type     ><   space
        AND  w_e070-trfunction   ><   cofa_order_type )
        OR   w_e070-trstatus     CA   relset.
          q_not_ok            =    k_x.
        ENDIF.
        IF   q_not_ok            =    space.
          PERFORM find_task_for_user
            USING    w_e070
            CHANGING w_found.
          IF   w_found        ><   space.
            cofa_v_order   =    w_e070-trkorr.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
***check if task can be used                                      ******
***      check task-type                                          ******
        IF   cofa_task_type      ><   space
        AND  w_e070-trfunction   ><   cofa_task_type.
          q_not_ok            =    k_x.
        ENDIF.
***      it must be a task with order                             ******
        IF w_e070-strkorr   = space.
          q_not_ok            =    k_x.
        ELSE.
***      order must be of correct order_type                      ******
          SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_order_strkorr
                          WHERE trkorr =  w_e070-strkorr.
          IF sy-subrc >< 0
          OR (     cofa_order_type             >< space
               AND ls_order_strkorr-trfunction >< cofa_order_type
              )
          OR  ls_order_strkorr-trstatus   CA   relset.
            q_not_ok            =    k_x.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        IF   q_not_ok            =    space
        AND  w_e070-as4user      =    sy-uname.
          cofa_v_task         =    w_e070-trkorr.
          cofa_v_order        =    w_e070-strkorr.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    "check_order_for_append

    PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING pt_enqueue.
    CASE pv_raise.

        MESSAGE  ID pv_msgid   TYPE 'E'  NUMBER pv_msgno
                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_central_basis.          "#EC *
      WHEN  gc_raise1_closed_ale_object.                    "#EC *
        MESSAGE  ID pv_msgid   TYPE 'E'  NUMBER pv_msgno
                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_closed_ale_object.      "#EC *
      WHEN  gc_raise1_closed_client.                        "#EC *
        MESSAGE  ID pv_msgid   TYPE 'E'  NUMBER pv_msgno
                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_closed_client.          "#EC *
      WHEN  gc_raise1_closed_system.                        "#EC *
        MESSAGE  ID pv_msgid   TYPE 'E'  NUMBER pv_msgno
                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_closed_system.          "#EC *
      WHEN  gc_raise1_ddic_in_customer_sys.                 "#EC *
        MESSAGE  ID pv_msgid   TYPE 'E'  NUMBER pv_msgno
                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4

      WHEN  gc_raise1_different_ordertypes.                 "#EC *

                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_different_ordertypes.   "#EC *

                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_different_tasktypes.    "#EC *
      WHEN  gc_raise1_enqueue_failed.                       "#EC *

                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_enqueue_failed.         "#EC *

                 RAISING  show_only_mixed_orders.           "#EC *

        MESSAGE  ID pv_msgid   TYPE 'E'  NUMBER pv_msgno
                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_mix_local_transp_obj.   "#EC *
      WHEN  gc_raise1_no_license.                           "#EC *
        MESSAGE  ID pv_msgid   TYPE 'E'  NUMBER pv_msgno
                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_no_license.             "#EC *
      WHEN  gc_raise1_no_repair_system.                     "#EC *

                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_no_repair_system.       "#EC *

                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4

                 RAISING  show_only_repaired_object.        "#EC *

        MESSAGE  ID pv_msgid   TYPE 'E'  NUMBER pv_msgno
                 WITH pv_msgv1 pv_msgv2 pv_msgv3 pv_msgv4
                 RAISING  show_only_show_client.            "#EC *

                 RAISING  cancel_edit_system_error.         "#EC *

  ELSE.
    MOVE  space  TO  lv_func_show.

  ENDIF.

****when show-option is active, additional text on Poppup 351   ********

  MOVE  pv_msgv4  TO  lv_msgv4.

      iv_msgv4          = lv_msgv4

      it_e071k          = pt_e071k
    IMPORTING
      ev_function       = lv_function
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS            = 1.

  IF  sy-subrc >< 0.
***unexpected error occured on popup ***********************************
    PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING pt_enqueue.
    MESSAGE  ID     'TK'
             TYPE   'E'
             NUMBER  495
             RAISING cancel_edit_user_after_error.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING pt_enqueue.

  IF  lv_function  =  'CANC'.
***user has cancelled                        ***************************
    MESSAGE  ID     'TK'
             TYPE   'E'
             NUMBER  653
             RAISING cancel_edit_user_after_error.
  ELSEIF lv_function  =  'SHOW'.

    MESSAGE e026(tr) RAISING show_only_user_after_error.
  ELSE.

***  Error:  cancel edit

    MESSAGE  ID     'TK'
             TYPE   'E'
             NUMBER  653
             RAISING cancel_edit_user_after_error.

                      WHERE msgid = ps_coll_err-msgid
                      AND   msgno = ps_coll_err-msgno.

    lv_found = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF lv_found = space.
***message occurs first time
***fill object-specific message table
    ps_coll_err-sent = space.
    INSERT ps_coll_err INTO TABLE pt_coll_err.
    lv_ready = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_ready = space.
    READ TABLE pt_coll_err WITH KEY msgid = ps_coll_err-msgid
                                    msgno = ps_coll_err-msgno
                                    sent = 'M'
                           INTO     ls_coll_err.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
***message already occured
***entry in condensed error tabele is already made
***set sent-status to M for new entry in object dependent table
      ps_coll_err-sent = 'M'.
      INSERT ps_coll_err INTO TABLE pt_coll_err.
      lv_ready = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_ready = space.
    READ TABLE pt_coll_err WITH KEY msgid = ps_coll_err-msgid
                                    msgno = ps_coll_err-msgno
                                    sent = ' '
                           INTO     ls_coll_err.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
***message already occured
***message was not sent
***set sent-status M for this message for all objects in
***object-specific message table
      ps_coll_err-sent = 'M'.
      MODIFY pt_coll_err FROM ps_coll_err
                         TRANSPORTING sent
                         WHERE msgid = ps_coll_err-msgid
                         AND   msgno = ps_coll_err-msgno.

***make new entry in object-specific table with sent = 'M'
      INSERT ps_coll_err INTO TABLE pt_coll_err.

***fill condensed error table with object independent message
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ps_coll_err TO ls_coll_err_cond.
      PERFORM convert_single_to_mass_message CHANGING ls_coll_err_cond.
      INSERT ls_coll_err_cond INTO TABLE pt_coll_err_cond.
    ENDIF.
    lv_ready = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_ready = space.
    READ TABLE pt_coll_err WITH KEY msgid = ps_coll_err-msgid
                                      msgno = ps_coll_err-msgno
                                      sent = 'X'
                             INTO     ls_coll_err.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
***message already occured
***Object-specific message was sent
      IF  ps_coll_err-pgmid    = ls_coll_err-pgmid
      AND ps_coll_err-object   = ls_coll_err-object
      AND ps_coll_err-obj_name = ls_coll_err-obj_name.
**same object for wich message was sent --> do nothing
      ELSE.
***message occurs for another object and mass  message not sent
***set sent-status M for this message for all objects in
***object-specific message table
        ps_coll_err-sent = 'M'.
        MODIFY pt_coll_err FROM ps_coll_err
                           TRANSPORTING sent
                           WHERE msgid = ps_coll_err-msgid
                           AND   msgno = ps_coll_err-msgno.

***make new entry in object-specific table with sent = 'M'
        INSERT ps_coll_err INTO TABLE pt_coll_err.

***fill condensed error table with object independent message
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING ps_coll_err TO ls_coll_err_cond.
        PERFORM convert_single_to_mass_message CHANGING ls_coll_err_cond.
        INSERT ls_coll_err_cond INTO TABLE pt_coll_err_cond.

        lv_ready = 'X'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.                               " FILL_ERR_TABS

FORM convert_single_to_mass_message CHANGING ps_err_cond TYPE
  ty_err_cond.

  CASE ps_err_cond-msgid.

        WHEN '852'.

FORM get_order_and_task_from_locks USING ps_lock_key STRUCTURE tlock_int
                                          pv_input_order
                                          pv_append_to_order
                                          pv_current_object
                                          pv_with_dialog
                                          pv_send_message
                                          pv_no_show_option
                                          pt_enqueue TYPE tt_enqueue
                                          pt_e071 TYPE ty_ko200s
                                          pt_e071k TYPE ty_e071ks
                                          pv_e071_tabix
                                          ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call
                                 CHANGING pv_order
                                          pv_task
                                          pq_unlocked
                                          ps_result TYPE sctsa_s_result.

  DATA: lv_lock_flag      TYPE c,
        lt_obj_lcks       TYPE trtlocks,
        ls_lock_max       TYPE tlock,
        lt_obj_lck_orders TYPE ty_obj_lck_orders,
        lv_order_conf     TYPE c,
        lv_conf_order_a   TYPE trkorr,
        lv_conf_order_b   TYPE trkorr,
        lv_conf_single_task TYPE trkorr,
        lv_ok_order       TYPE trkorr,
        ls_e071           TYPE ko200.

  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CHECK_LOCKS'
    EXPORTING
      wi_lock_key = ps_lock_key
    IMPORTING
      we_lockflag = lv_lock_flag
      we_tlock    = ls_lock_max
    TABLES
      wt_tlock    = lt_obj_lcks.

  IF lv_lock_flag = space.
**object not locked
    pq_unlocked = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  IF ps_lock_key-hi > ls_lock_max-hikey.
**we now want a bigger lock
    pq_unlocked = 'X'.
  ELSE.
**lockrange is big enough. But handle DDIC exception
    READ TABLE pt_e071 INDEX pv_e071_tabix INTO ls_e071 .
    PERFORM set_ddic_unlocked USING    ls_e071
                              CHANGING pq_unlocked.
  ENDIF.


**object somehow locked, get ordernumber of locks
  PERFORM get_lock_orders USING    lt_obj_lcks
                          CHANGING lt_obj_lck_orders.

**only locks for same order are allowed
  PERFORM find_lock_order_conf USING    lt_obj_lck_orders
                               CHANGING lv_order_conf
                                        lv_conf_order_a
                                        lv_conf_order_b
                                        lv_conf_single_task
                                        lv_ok_order.

  IF lv_order_conf >< space.
**error --> abort (no return from error routine)
    IF lv_conf_single_task >< space.
*******task without order
      PERFORM raise_error
              USING  pt_enqueue pt_e071 pt_e071k
                     pv_e071_tabix
                     'TK'
                      063
                     pv_current_object
                     lv_conf_single_task
                     ' '
                     ' '
                     pv_with_dialog
                     pv_send_message
                     pv_no_show_option
                     ps_api_call
                     gc_raise1_mixed_orders
              CHANGING ps_result.

    ENDIF.
    IF lv_conf_order_a >< lv_conf_order_b.
      PERFORM raise_error
             USING  pt_enqueue pt_e071 pt_e071k
                    pv_e071_tabix
                    'TK'
                     066
                    pv_current_object
                    lv_conf_order_a
                    lv_conf_order_b
                    ' '
                    pv_with_dialog
                    pv_send_message
                    pv_no_show_option
                    ps_api_call
                    gc_raise1_mixed_orders
             CHANGING ps_result.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.


  IF  lv_ok_order >< pv_order
  AND pv_order    >< space.
**error --> abort (no return from error routine)
    MESSAGE e067(tk).
    PERFORM raise_error
             USING  pt_enqueue pt_e071 pt_e071k
                    pv_e071_tabix
                    'TK'
                     066
                    lv_ok_order
                    pv_order
                    ' '
                    ' '
                    pv_with_dialog
                    pv_send_message
                    pv_no_show_option
                    ps_api_call
                    gc_raise1_mixed_orders
             CHANGING ps_result.
  ENDIF.

  IF pv_append_to_order >< space.
    IF  lv_ok_order >< space
    AND lv_ok_order >< pv_input_order.
***input must be used, when appending to order
***error, no return from raise_error
      PERFORM  raise_error
             USING    pt_enqueue pt_e071 pt_e071k
                      0
                      'TK'
                      '070'
                      pv_input_order
                      lv_ok_order
                      ' ' ' '
                      pv_with_dialog
                      pv_send_message pv_no_show_option
                      ps_api_call
                      gc_raise1_mixed_orders
             CHANGING ps_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

***lock-order of this object can be used for append.
  pv_order = lv_ok_order.


ENDFORM.                               " GET_ORDER_AND_TASK_FROM_LOCKS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GET_LOCK_ORDERS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_lock_orders USING    pt_obj_lcks TYPE trtlocks
                      CHANGING pt_obj_lck_orders TYPE ty_obj_lck_orders.

  DATA: ls_e070 TYPE e070,
        ls_obj_lck TYPE tlock,
        ls_obj_lck_order TYPE ty_obj_lck_order .

  LOOP AT pt_obj_lcks INTO ls_obj_lck.
    CLEAR ls_obj_lck_order.
    IF ls_obj_lck-edtflag >< space.
***lock on task
*****Read task, to get related order from strkorr
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_e070
                      WHERE trkorr = ls_obj_lck-trkorr.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_obj_lck_order-orderno = ls_e070-strkorr.
      ENDIF.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_obj_lck TO ls_obj_lck_order.
      APPEND ls_obj_lck_order TO pt_obj_lck_orders.
    ELSE.
***lock on order
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_obj_lck TO ls_obj_lck_order.
      ls_obj_lck_order-orderno = ls_obj_lck-trkorr.
      APPEND ls_obj_lck_order TO pt_obj_lck_orders.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                               " GET_LOCK_ORDERS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FIND_LOCK_ORDER_CONF
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM find_lock_order_conf USING pt_obj_lck_orders TYPE ty_obj_lck_orders
                            CHANGING pv_order_conf
                                     pv_conf_order_a
                                     pv_conf_order_b
                                     pv_conf_single_task
                                     pv_ok_order.

  DATA: ls_obj_lck_order TYPE ty_obj_lck_order.
  CLEAR: pv_conf_order_a, pv_conf_order_b, pv_conf_single_task,
         pv_order_conf.

**check for single task
  READ TABLE pt_obj_lck_orders WITH KEY  orderno = space
                                    INTO ls_obj_lck_order.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    pv_conf_single_task = ls_obj_lck_order-trkorr.
    pv_order_conf       = 'X'.
**do not exit, continue with checks on different orders
  ENDIF.

**check for different orders
  LOOP AT pt_obj_lck_orders INTO ls_obj_lck_order
                            WHERE orderno >< space.
    IF pv_conf_order_a IS INITIAL.
      pv_conf_order_a = ls_obj_lck_order-orderno.
    ELSEIF ls_obj_lck_order-orderno >< pv_conf_order_a.
      pv_conf_order_b = ls_obj_lck_order-orderno.
      pv_order_conf = 'X'.
**one conflict with different orders is enogh, exit loop and form
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  CHECK pv_order_conf = space.
**no error -> return the only one order
  pv_ok_order = ls_obj_lck_order-orderno.

ENDFORM.                               " FIND_LOCK_ORDER_CONF

*&      Form  SUGGEST_ORDER  for TOC
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* when appending to order: check pv_order vs pv_input_order
*                          nothing but the input is allowed
* when pv_order is space : try to use input
*                          try to use last used order
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM suggest_order USING    pt_enqueue TYPE tt_enqueue
                              pt_e071 TYPE tredt_objects
                              pt_e071k TYPE tredt_keys
                              pv_with_dialog
                              pv_send_message
                              pv_no_show_option
                              pv_input_order
                              pv_no_ps
                              pv_ps_order
                              pv_task_type
                              pv_request_type
                              pv_category
                              pv_cli_dep
                              pv_append_to_order
                              ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call
                     CHANGING pv_order
                              pv_task
                              pv_dark_set_order
                              ps_result TYPE sctsa_s_result.


  DATA: lv_ps_v_order_project    TYPE trkorr_p,
        lt_e070use TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e070use WITH DEFAULT KEY,
        ls_e070use TYPE e070use,
        lv_uname TYPE sy-uname.

***********************************************************************
**first when appending to order use input. Checks will be done in TOC
***********************************************************************

  IF pv_append_to_order >< space
  AND pv_order = space.
    pv_order = pv_input_order.
***all done when appending to order
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

***********************************************************************
**second try to find suggestion for TOC when appending to task
***********************************************************************

  IF   pv_task    =    space
  AND  pv_order   =    space.
*****first check input order ***************************************
    IF   pv_input_order       ><   space.
      PERFORM check_order_for_append  USING pv_input_order
                         pv_category    pv_cli_dep
                         pv_request_type  pv_task_type
                         pv_order       pv_task.
    ENDIF.
***when input ok it is now in V_ORDER. check if correct project
    IF pv_order >< space
    AND pv_no_ps = space.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TR_GET_PROJECT_OF_REQUEST'
        EXPORTING
          iv_trkorr  = pv_order
        IMPORTING
          ev_project = lv_ps_v_order_project.
      IF lv_ps_v_order_project >< pv_ps_order.
        pv_order = space.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
*** second try order from order administration
    IF   pv_order                  =    space
    AND  pv_task                   =    space
    AND  pv_task_type              ><   space
    AND  pv_request_type             ><   space
    AND  pv_category               ><   space.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TR_TASK_GET'
        EXPORTING
          iv_username = sy-uname
          iv_category = pv_category
          iv_client   = sy-mandt
        TABLES
          tt_e070use  = lt_e070use
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS      = 01.
      IF   sy-subrc  =    0.
        LOOP AT lt_e070use INTO ls_e070use.
          IF   ls_e070use-ordernum >< space.
*******V_order may be filled in this form
            PERFORM check_order_for_append
                    USING ls_e070use-ordernum
                    pv_category    pv_cli_dep
                    pv_request_type  pv_task_type
                    pv_order       pv_task.
          ENDIF.
          EXIT.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
*********check if V_order is assinged to correct project
    IF pv_order >< space
    AND pv_no_ps = space.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TR_GET_PROJECT_OF_REQUEST'
        EXPORTING
          iv_trkorr  = pv_order
        IMPORTING
          ev_project = lv_ps_v_order_project.
      IF lv_ps_v_order_project >< pv_ps_order.
        pv_order = space.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

****                                                                ****
    IF   pv_task         ><   space
*      AND  lq_unlocked    =    k_x              "gsf unlock
    AND  pv_with_dialog CA  'XD'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'
        EXPORTING
          trkorr       = pv_task
        EXCEPTIONS
          foreign_lock = 1.
      IF   sy-subrc  ><   0.
        lv_uname  =    sy-msgv1.
        PERFORM  raise_error
                 USING  pt_enqueue pt_e071 pt_e071k
                        0 'TR' 860
                        pv_task
                        ' '
                        lv_uname
                         ' '
                        pv_with_dialog
                        pv_send_message
                        pv_no_show_option
                        ps_api_call
                        gc_raise1_enqueue_failed
                 CHANGING ps_result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    IF   pv_order             ><   space.
      pv_dark_set_order   =    k_x.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                               " SUGGEST_ORDER
