*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  READ_Request_task_from_lock
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Read request and task for trkorr of a tlock entry
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_request_task_from_lock
  USING    ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call
           pv_lock_trkorr TYPE trkorr
  CHANGING ps_objprops TYPE sctsa_s_object_props
           ps_request TYPE e070
           ps_task TYPE e070
           pv_not_found TYPE trboolean
           pv_inconsistent_task TYPE trboolean.

  DATA: ls_e070 TYPE e070,
        ls_request TYPE trwbo_request,
        ls_rtpair TYPE sctsa_s_rtpair.

  CLEAR: ps_request, ps_task, pv_not_found, pv_inconsistent_task.

  IF ps_api_call-is_api = space.
* for classical invocation only read the e070 entries and do not update ps_objprops
* This is faster.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_e070
      WHERE trkorr = pv_lock_trkorr.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      pv_not_found = 'X'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_e070-trfunction CA sctsc_types_tasks.
* lock is on task
      ps_task = ls_e070.
      IF ps_task-strkorr <> space.
* task is assigned to request; read request
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_e070
          WHERE trkorr = ps_task-strkorr.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          pv_inconsistent_task = 'X'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        ps_request = ls_e070.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
* lock is on request
      ps_request = ls_e070.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
* In case of remote WBO API invocation read task/request with text, client and attributes
* and add these to ps_objprops-locks.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_READ_REQUEST'
      EXPORTING
        iv_read_e070       = 'X'
        iv_read_e07t       = 'X'
        iv_read_e070c      = 'X'
        iv_read_attributes = 'X'
        iv_trkorr          = pv_lock_trkorr
      CHANGING
        cs_request         = ls_request
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS             = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      pv_not_found = 'X'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_request-h-trfunction CA sctsc_types_tasks.
* lock is on task
      ls_rtpair-task = ls_request-h.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_request-h TO ps_task.
      IF ps_task-strkorr <> space.
* task is assigned to request; read request
        CLEAR ls_request.
        CALL FUNCTION 'TR_READ_REQUEST'
          EXPORTING
            iv_read_e070       = 'X'
            iv_read_e07t       = 'X'
            iv_read_e070c      = 'X'
            iv_read_attributes = 'X'
            iv_trkorr          = ps_task-strkorr
          CHANGING
            cs_request         = ls_request
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS             = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          pv_inconsistent_task = 'X'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        ls_rtpair-request = ls_request.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_request-h TO ps_request.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
* lock is on request
      ls_rtpair-request = ls_request.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_request-h TO ps_request.
    ENDIF.
* update ps_objprops-locks
    APPEND ls_rtpair TO ps_objprops-locks.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " READ_Request_task_from_lock

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  check_api_call_params
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Check correctness of parameters for remote WBO API invocation
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_api_call_params
  USING    ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call
           ps_m TYPE gty_multi_panel
  CHANGING ps_g TYPE gty_global_panel
           ps_result TYPE sctsa_s_result.

  DATA: lr_attr TYPE REF TO cts_req_attr,
        ls_attr_key TYPE cts_req_attr_key,
        lr_attr_key TYPE REF TO cts_req_attr_key,
        ls_create_attr TYPE scts_attr,
        lr_create_attr TYPE REF TO scts_attr,
        lt_wboattrs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF wboattr,
        lr_wboattr TYPE REF TO wboattr,
        lv_last_attr TYPE trattr.

* 1) Initialization of object independant control panel
* fill and sort attribute keys for selection and attributes for creation of requests
  CLEAR: ps_g-attribute_keys , ps_g-attributes.
  LOOP AT ps_api_call-attributes REFERENCE INTO lr_attr.
    ls_attr_key-attribute = lr_attr->attribute.
    APPEND ls_attr_key TO ps_g-attribute_keys.
    ls_create_attr-attribute = lr_attr->attribute.
    ls_create_attr-value = lr_attr->reference.
    APPEND ls_create_attr TO ps_g-attributes.
  ENDLOOP.
  SORT ps_g-attribute_keys BY attribute.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ps_g-attribute_keys COMPARING attribute.
  SORT ps_g-attributes BY attribute value.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ps_g-attributes COMPARING attribute value.
* Store info on authorizations of current user
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
    EXPORTING
      iv_trfunction  = sctsc_type_workbench
      iv_activity    = 'CREA'
    EXCEPTIONS
      e_no_authority = 1.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    ps_g-req_workbench_create = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
    EXPORTING
      iv_trfunction  = sctsc_type_customizing
      iv_activity    = 'CREA'
    EXCEPTIONS
      e_no_authority = 1.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    ps_g-req_customizing_create = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
* No dependencies on implementation details of authority check:
* Treat different task types separately.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
    EXPORTING
      iv_trfunction  = sctsc_type_correction
      iv_activity    = 'CREA'
    EXCEPTIONS
      e_no_authority = 1.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    ps_g-task_correction_create = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
    EXPORTING
      iv_trfunction  = sctsc_type_repair
      iv_activity    = 'CREA'
    EXCEPTIONS
      e_no_authority = 1.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    ps_g-task_repair_create = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
    EXPORTING
      iv_trfunction  = sctsc_type_cust_task
      iv_activity    = 'CREA'
    EXCEPTIONS
      e_no_authority = 1.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    ps_g-task_customizing_create = 'X'.
  ENDIF.


* 2) Basic checks of invocation parameters

* 3) Check of request attributes
  IF ps_g-attribute_keys IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT * FROM wboattr INTO TABLE lt_wboattrs ORDER BY attr.
* In any case check attributes for selection of request
    LOOP AT ps_g-attribute_keys REFERENCE INTO lr_attr_key.
      READ TABLE lt_wboattrs REFERENCE INTO lr_wboattr
        WITH KEY attr = lr_attr_key->attribute
        BINARY SEARCH.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 030
          lr_attr_key->attribute space space space ps_result.
      ELSEIF lr_attr_key->attribute = sctsa_bcf_srvprovider
        OR   lr_attr_key->attribute = sctsa_export_timestamp
        OR   lr_attr_key->attribute = sctsa_sap_cts_project
        OR   lr_wboattr->externally = 'X'.
        append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 031
          lr_attr_key->attribute space space space ps_result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF ps_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF    ps_api_call-is_insert = 'X'
      AND ps_api_call-new_request = 'X'.
* Checks on attributes for creation of requests
      CLEAR lv_last_attr.
      LOOP AT ps_g-attributes REFERENCE INTO lr_create_attr.
        READ TABLE lt_wboattrs REFERENCE INTO lr_wboattr
          WITH KEY attr = lr_create_attr->attribute
          BINARY SEARCH.
        IF    lr_create_attr->value = space
          AND lr_wboattr->reference = 'X'.
          append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 032
            lr_attr_key->attribute space space space ps_result.
        ENDIF.
        IF    lr_create_attr->attribute = lv_last_attr
          AND lr_wboattr->unique_ = 'X'.
          append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 033
            lr_attr_key->attribute space space space ps_result.
        ENDIF.
        lv_last_attr = lr_create_attr->attribute.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  IF ps_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* Include initial check on specified request of insert invocation!
  IF ps_api_call-request <> space.
    PERFORM check_request_for_recording
      USING
        ps_api_call-request
        space
        ps_api_call
        ps_m
        ps_g
      CHANGING
        ps_result-request
        ps_result-task
        ps_result-repair
        ps_result.
    IF ps_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " check_api_call_params

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  check_request_for_recording
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Check, if a request can be used for recording
*       If pv_for_append is marked, enqueue request and create
*       tasks, if needed, and fill ps_task and/or ps_repair for found
*       or newly created tasks and enqueue these.
*       Remove any enqueues in case of any error.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_request_for_recording
  USING    pv_trkorr TYPE trkorr
           pv_for_append TYPE trboolean
           ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call                "#EC NEEDED
           ps_m TYPE gty_multi_panel
           ps_g TYPE gty_global_panel
  CHANGING ps_request TYPE trwbo_request
           ps_task TYPE trwbo_request_header
           ps_repair TYPE trwbo_request_header
           ps_result TYPE sctsa_s_result.

  DATA: lv_user_msgv TYPE symsgv,
        lr_attr_key TYPE REF TO cts_req_attr_key,
        lr_e070a TYPE REF TO e070a,
        lv_task_type TYPE trfunction,
        lv_task TYPE trkorr,
        lv_repair TYPE trkorr,
        lr_unclassified TYPE REF TO trkorr,
        lt_unclassified TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF trkorr,
        lv_new_needed TYPE i,
        lv_unclassified_needed TYPE i,
        lv_unclassified_needed_t TYPE trboolean,
        lv_unclassified_needed_r TYPE trboolean,
        lv_unclassified_found TYPE i.

  CLEAR: ps_request, ps_task, ps_repair.

* trkorr must be specified
  IF pv_trkorr = space.
    append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 036
      'REQUEST_FOR_CHECK_UNKNOWN' space space space ps_result.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* When invoked for append, additional attributes must be known
  IF pv_for_append = 'X'.
    IF ps_m-task_types_determined = space
    OR ps_m-request_type = space
    OR ps_m-unknown_tadir = 'X'.
      append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 046
        'CHECK_REQUEST_FAILED' space space space ps_result.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

* Short cut: if locks exist, only one request can be used. Check this first.
  IF    ps_m-recording-request <> space
    AND pv_trkorr <> ps_m-recording-request.
    append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 020
      ps_m-recording-request_obj_text pv_trkorr
      ps_m-recording-request ps_m-recording-request_owner ps_result.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* Lock request if invoked for append
  IF pv_for_append = 'X'.
    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'
      EXPORTING
        trkorr       = pv_trkorr
      EXCEPTIONS
        foreign_lock = 1
        OTHERS       = 2.
    IF sy-subrc = 1.
      lv_user_msgv = sy-msgv1.
      append_error_message 'TK' 133
        pv_trkorr lv_user_msgv space space ps_result.
      RETURN.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc <> 0.
      append_current_error_message ps_result.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

* Read request
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_READ_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      iv_read_e070       = 'X'
      iv_read_e07t       = 'X'
      iv_read_e070c      = 'X'
      iv_read_attributes = 'X'
      iv_trkorr          = pv_trkorr
    CHANGING
      cs_request         = ps_request
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS             = 1.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    append_current_error_message ps_result.
    dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
* Sort attributes
  SORT ps_request-attributes BY attribute reference pos.

* Check basic attributes
* Type
  IF ps_request-h-trfunction NA sctsc_types_projects.
    append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 037
      pv_trkorr ps_request-h-trfunction space space ps_result.
    dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
* Status
  IF ps_request-h-trstatus NA sctsc_states_changeable.
    append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 038
      pv_trkorr ps_request-h-trstatus space space ps_result.
    dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
* Client
  IF ps_request-h-client <> sy-mandt.
    append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 039
      pv_trkorr ps_request-h-client space space ps_result.
    dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* Check request attributes
  LOOP AT ps_g-attribute_keys REFERENCE INTO lr_attr_key.
    READ TABLE ps_request-attributes TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
      WITH KEY attribute = lr_attr_key->attribute
      BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 043
        pv_trkorr lr_attr_key->attribute space space ps_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF ps_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
    dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* Check more about request if we know more
* Request type
* We explicitely allow customizing objects to be recorded in Workbench requests
  IF    ps_m-request_type = sctsc_type_workbench
    AND ps_request-h-trfunction <> ps_m-request_type.
    append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 044
      pv_trkorr space space space ps_result.
    dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
* Target system
  IF ps_m-tarsystem = gc_local_target.
    IF ps_request-h-tarsystem <> space.
      append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 047
        pv_trkorr space ps_request-h-tarsystem space ps_result.
      dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ELSEIF ps_m-tarsystem <> space.
    IF ps_request-h-tarsystem <> ps_m-tarsystem.
      append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 048
        pv_trkorr ps_m-tarsystem ps_request-h-tarsystem space ps_result.
      dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

* Check existence of required task(s) for current user
* If not found, check for possibility to create new task
* First check for authorization, since this is more fundamental
* Do not invoke TR_INSERT_NEW_COMM in simulation mode for performance reasons!
  IF ps_m-task_types_determined = space.
* Initial checks: Just check for existence of task of any type
* Do not check for tasks of deprecated state 'L'
    SELECT trkorr FROM e070 UP TO 1 ROWS INTO lv_task
      WHERE strkorr    = ps_request-h-trkorr
      AND   as4user    = sy-uname
      AND   trstatus   = sctsc_state_changeable.
    ENDSELECT.
    IF  lv_task = space
    AND ps_g-task_correction_create = space.  " any task type
      append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 050
        pv_trkorr space space space ps_result.
      dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
* Here we now, what task types are needed.
* No dependencies on implementation details of authority check:
* Treat different task types separately.
* Do not check for tasks of deprecated state 'L'
    IF ps_m-task_append_needed = 'X'.
      IF ps_request-h-trfunction = sctsc_type_workbench.
        lv_task_type = sctsc_type_correction.
      ELSE.
        lv_task_type = sctsc_type_cust_task.
      ENDIF.
      SELECT trkorr FROM e070 UP TO 1 ROWS INTO lv_task
        WHERE strkorr    = ps_request-h-trkorr
        AND   as4user    = sy-uname
        AND   trfunction = lv_task_type
        AND   trstatus   = sctsc_state_changeable.
      ENDSELECT.
      IF lv_task = space.
        IF lv_task_type = sctsc_type_correction.
          ADD 1 TO lv_new_needed.
          IF ps_g-task_correction_create = space.
            ADD 1 TO lv_unclassified_needed.
            lv_unclassified_needed_t = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSEIF lv_task_type = sctsc_type_cust_task
          AND ps_g-task_customizing_create = space.
* new customizing task has to be created, but authorization is missing
          append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 050
            pv_trkorr space space space ps_result.
          dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    IF ps_m-repair_append_needed = 'X'.
      SELECT trkorr FROM e070 UP TO 1 ROWS INTO lv_repair
        WHERE strkorr    = ps_request-h-trkorr
        AND   as4user    = sy-uname
        AND   trfunction = sctsc_type_repair
        AND   trstatus   = sctsc_state_changeable.
      ENDSELECT.
      IF  lv_repair = space.
        ADD 1 TO lv_new_needed.
        IF ps_g-task_repair_create = space.
          ADD 1 TO lv_unclassified_needed.
          lv_unclassified_needed_r = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_new_needed > 0.
* search for unclassified tasks, even if new tasks can be created,
* since existing tasks have preference
      SELECT trkorr FROM e070 INTO TABLE lt_unclassified
        WHERE strkorr    = ps_request-h-trkorr
        AND   as4user    = sy-uname
        AND   trfunction = sctsc_type_unclass_task
        AND   trstatus   = sctsc_state_changeable.
      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_unclassified LINES lv_unclassified_found.
      IF lv_unclassified_found < lv_unclassified_needed.
* new tasks have to be created, but authorization is missing
        append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 050
          pv_trkorr space space space ps_result.
        dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
* assign unclassified tasks
    LOOP AT lt_unclassified REFERENCE INTO lr_unclassified.
      IF lv_unclassified_needed_t EQ 'X'.
        lv_task = lr_unclassified->*.
        CLEAR lv_unclassified_needed_t.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_unclassified_needed_r EQ 'X'.
        lv_repair = lr_unclassified->*.
        CLEAR lv_unclassified_needed_r.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      IF ( ps_m-task_append_needed = 'X' ) AND ( lv_task = space ).
        lv_task = lr_unclassified->*.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      IF ( ps_m-repair_append_needed = 'X' ) AND ( lv_repair = space ).
        lv_repair = lr_unclassified->*.
      ENDIF.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDIF.

  IF  ( ps_m-task_types_determined = space
    AND lv_task = space )
  OR  ( ps_m-task_append_needed = 'X'
    AND lv_task = space )
  OR  ( ps_m-repair_append_needed = 'X'
    AND lv_repair = space ).
* Foreign request locked by owner cannot be used
    IF  ps_request-h-as4user <> sy-uname
    AND ps_request-h-trstatus = sctsc_state_protected.     "#EC USER_OK
      append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 049
        pv_trkorr ps_request-h-as4user space space ps_result.
      dequeue_trkorr_conditional pv_trkorr pv_for_append.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

* Return, if not in append mode
  IF pv_for_append = space.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* ps_m-task_types_determined is marked (checked in the beginning)
* and thus ps_m-task_append_needed, ps_m-repair_append_needed are filled correctly
  IF ps_m-task_append_needed = 'X'.
    PERFORM check_or_create_task
      USING
        lv_task
        lv_task_type
        ps_request
        ps_api_call
      CHANGING
        ps_task
        ps_result.
    IF ps_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
      dequeue_trkorr pv_trkorr.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF ps_m-repair_append_needed = 'X'.
    PERFORM check_or_create_task
      USING
        lv_repair
        sctsc_type_repair
        ps_request
        ps_api_call
      CHANGING
        ps_repair
        ps_result.
    IF ps_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
      dequeue_trkorr_conditional ps_task-trkorr ps_m-task_append_needed.
      dequeue_trkorr pv_trkorr.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " check_request_for_recording

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  select_requests_for_recording
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Select existing requests which can be used for recording.
*       First candidates are selected. These candidates are checked.
*       If no candidate can be used and no new request can be created,
*       error messages for all candidates are returned.
*       If at least one candidate can be used or newly created,
*       error messages for other candidates are ommited.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM select_requests_for_recording
  USING    ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call
           ps_m TYPE gty_multi_panel
           ps_g TYPE gty_global_panel
  CHANGING pt_requests TYPE trwbo_requests
           ps_result TYPE sctsa_s_result.

  DATA: ls_result TYPE sctsa_s_result,
        ls_result_collection TYPE sctsa_s_result,
        lt_req_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF trkorr,
        lr_req_id TYPE REF TO trkorr,
        lt_task_req_refs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF trkorr,
        ls_request TYPE trwbo_request,
        ls_task_dummy TYPE trwbo_request_header,
        ls_repair_dummy TYPE trwbo_request_header,
        ls_ranges TYPE trsel_ts_ranges,
        ls_trkorr_range TYPE trsel_trs_trkorr,
        ls_as4user_range TYPE trsel_trs_as4user,
        ls_trstatus_range TYPE trsel_trs_status,
        ls_trfunction_range TYPE trsel_trs_function,
        ls_tarsystem_range TYPE trsel_trs_tarsystem,
        ls_client_range TYPE trsel_trs_client.

  CLEAR pt_requests.
  ls_result_collection-result = sctsa_result_ok.

* Determine candidates. 2 cases.
  IF ps_m-recording-request <> space.
* Case 1: Some objects are locked for a request. This is the only candidate.
    PERFORM check_request_for_recording
      USING
        ps_m-recording-request
        space
        ps_api_call
        ps_m
        ps_g
      CHANGING
        ls_request
        ls_task_dummy
        ls_repair_dummy
        ps_result.
    IF ps_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND ls_request TO pt_requests.
    ps_result-existing_req_only = 'X'.
    RETURN.
  ELSE.
* Case 2: No request restriction (may occur in check case only!)
* Only send an error, if no usable request is found and authorization for
* creation of a new request is missing.
* Do own optimized SQL selection from e070 to speed this up.
* Select options for trkorr
    ls_trkorr_range-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_trkorr_range-option = 'CP'.
    ls_trkorr_range-low    = system_name.
    ls_trkorr_range-low+3  = 'K*'.
    APPEND ls_trkorr_range TO ls_ranges-trkorr.
* Select options for as4user
* Typical cases are: user name fully specified; user name not specified at all ('*')
    IF ps_api_call-as4user <> '*'.  " Empty select-option if no user restriction is requested
      ls_as4user_range-sign   = 'I'.
      IF ps_api_call-as4user CA '*+'.
        ls_as4user_range-option = 'CP'.
      ELSE.
        ls_as4user_range-option = 'EQ'.
      ENDIF.
      ls_as4user_range-low    = ps_api_call-as4user.
      APPEND ls_as4user_range TO ls_ranges-as4user.
    ENDIF.
* Select options for request_status and for task_status
    ls_trstatus_range-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_trstatus_range-option = 'EQ'.
    ls_trstatus_range-low    = sctsc_state_changeable.
    APPEND ls_trstatus_range TO ls_ranges-request_status.
    APPEND ls_trstatus_range TO ls_ranges-task_status.
    ls_trstatus_range-low    = sctsc_state_protected.
    APPEND ls_trstatus_range TO ls_ranges-request_status.
* Select options for request_funcs and for task_funcs
* We explicitely allow customizing objects to be recorded in Workbench requests
    ls_trfunction_range-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_trfunction_range-option = 'EQ'.
    ls_trfunction_range-low    = sctsc_type_workbench.
    APPEND ls_trfunction_range TO ls_ranges-request_funcs.
    ls_trfunction_range-low    = sctsc_type_correction.
    APPEND ls_trfunction_range TO ls_ranges-task_funcs.
    ls_trfunction_range-low    = sctsc_type_repair.
    APPEND ls_trfunction_range TO ls_ranges-task_funcs.
    ls_trfunction_range-low    = sctsc_type_unclass_task.
    APPEND ls_trfunction_range TO ls_ranges-task_funcs.
    IF ps_m-request_type = space
    OR ps_m-request_type = sctsc_type_customizing.
      ls_trfunction_range-low    = sctsc_type_customizing.
      APPEND ls_trfunction_range TO ls_ranges-request_funcs.
      ls_trfunction_range-low    = sctsc_type_cust_task.
      APPEND ls_trfunction_range TO ls_ranges-task_funcs.
    ENDIF.
* Select options for tarsystem
    ls_tarsystem_range-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_tarsystem_range-option = 'EQ'.
    IF ps_m-tarsystem = gc_local_target.
      ls_tarsystem_range-low    = space.
      APPEND ls_tarsystem_range TO ls_ranges-tarsystem.
    ELSEIF ps_m-tarsystem <> space.
      ls_tarsystem_range-low    = ps_m-tarsystem.
      APPEND ls_tarsystem_range TO ls_ranges-tarsystem.
    ENDIF.
* Select options for client
    ls_client_range-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_client_range-option = 'EQ'.
    ls_client_range-low    = sy-mandt.
    APPEND ls_client_range TO ls_ranges-client.

* Select requests; ignore deprecated requests without e070c entry
* So inner join on e070 and e070c
    SELECT r~trkorr
      FROM e070 AS r INNER JOIN e070c AS c
                ON r~trkorr = c~trkorr
      INTO TABLE lt_req_ids
      WHERE r~trkorr     IN ls_ranges-trkorr
      AND   r~trfunction IN ls_ranges-request_funcs
      AND   r~trstatus   IN ls_ranges-request_status
      AND   r~tarsystem  IN ls_ranges-tarsystem
      AND   r~as4user    IN ls_ranges-as4user
      AND   c~client     IN ls_ranges-client.

    IF ps_api_call-as4user <> '*'.
* If user restriction is requested, also look for tasks contained in foreign requests
      SELECT t~strkorr
        FROM e070 AS t INNER JOIN e070c AS c
                  ON t~trkorr = c~trkorr
        INTO TABLE lt_task_req_refs
        WHERE t~trkorr     IN ls_ranges-trkorr
        AND   t~trfunction IN ls_ranges-task_funcs
        AND   t~trstatus   IN ls_ranges-task_status
        AND   t~as4user    IN ls_ranges-as4user
        AND   c~client     IN ls_ranges-client.
* Check result table is not empty!
      IF lt_task_req_refs IS NOT INITIAL.
* Select corresponding requests for any as4user.
* Observe: Correct trkorr, trfunction, trstatus and client are a consequence of task
* selection (if there is no data inconsistency), and will be checked anyway.
        SELECT trkorr
          FROM e070
          APPENDING TABLE lt_req_ids
          FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_task_req_refs
          WHERE trkorr     =  lt_task_req_refs-table_line
          AND   tarsystem  IN ls_ranges-tarsystem.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
* Sort found request numbers and remove duplicates
    SORT lt_req_ids BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_req_ids COMPARING table_line.

* Now check the found requests
    LOOP AT lt_req_ids REFERENCE INTO lr_req_id.
      CLEAR ls_result.
      ls_result-result = sctsa_result_ok.
      PERFORM check_request_for_recording
        USING
          lr_req_id->*
          space
          ps_api_call
          ps_m
          ps_g
        CHANGING
          ls_request
          ls_task_dummy
          ls_repair_dummy
          ls_result.
      IF ls_result-result = sctsa_result_ok.
* request can be used
        APPEND ls_request TO pt_requests.
      ENDIF.
      IF pt_requests IS INITIAL.
        PERFORM append_result_and_messages
          USING
            ls_result
          CHANGING
            ls_result_collection.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF pt_requests IS INITIAL.
* No usable request found. May a new one be created?
      IF ( ps_m-request_type = sctsc_type_workbench
        AND ps_g-req_workbench_create = space )
      OR ( ps_m-request_type = sctsc_type_customizing
        AND ps_g-req_customizing_create = space )
      OR ( ps_m-request_type = space               " should not occur
        AND ps_g-req_customizing_create = space ).
        PERFORM append_result_and_messages
          USING
            ls_result_collection
          CHANGING
            ps_result.
        append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 056
          space space space space ps_result.
        IF ps_m-request_type = sctsc_type_workbench.
          append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 057
            space space space space ps_result.
        ELSE.
          append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 058
            space space space space ps_result.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.  " Case 1/2/3

* Sort table of usable requests to achieve deterministic behavior in case
* one of the requests is choosen programatically.
  SORT pt_requests BY h-trkorr.

ENDFORM.                    " select_requests_for_recording

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  create_request_for_recording
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Create a new request for recording for the current user
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_request_for_recording
  USING    ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call
           ps_m TYPE gty_multi_panel
           ps_g TYPE gty_global_panel
  CHANGING ps_request_header TYPE trwbo_request_header
           ps_result TYPE sctsa_s_result.

  DATA: lv_text TYPE as4text.

  CLEAR ps_request_header.

* Check required attributes
  IF ps_m-request_type = space
  OR ps_m-unknown_tadir = 'X'.
    append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 046
      'CREATE_REQUEST_FAILED' space space space ps_result.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
* No check of authorization, since this will be done by TR_INSERT_REQUEST_WITH_TASKS

* Get short text from input or use generic short text
  IF ps_api_call-as4text <> space.
    lv_text = ps_api_call-as4text.
  ELSE.
    lv_text = 'Generated request for change recording'(rqg)."#EC *
  ENDIF.

  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_INSERT_REQUEST_WITH_TASKS'  " here: without tasks
    EXPORTING
      iv_type           = ps_m-request_type
      iv_text           = lv_text
      iv_owner          = sy-uname
      iv_target         = ps_m-tarsystem
      it_attributes     = ps_g-attributes
    IMPORTING
      es_request_header = ps_request_header
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS            = 1.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    append_current_error_message ps_result.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* Add message on successful creation
  append_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 'S' 063
    ps_request_header-trkorr sy-uname space space ps_result.

ENDFORM.                    " create_request_for_recording

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  check_or_create_task
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Create a new task, if it is not yet specified.
*       Enqueue, read and check the task.
*       Remove any enqueues in case of any error.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_or_create_task
  USING    pv_task TYPE trkorr
           pv_task_type TYPE trfunction
           ps_request TYPE trwbo_request
           ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call                "#EC NEEDED
  CHANGING ps_task TYPE trwbo_request_header
           ps_result TYPE sctsa_s_result.

  DATA: lv_user_msgv TYPE symsgv,
        lv_task TYPE trkorr,
        ls_e070 TYPE e070.

  CLEAR: ps_task.

  IF pv_task = space.
* Create new task
    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_INSERT_NEW_COMM'
      EXPORTING
        wi_kurztext   = ps_request-h-as4text
        wi_trfunction = pv_task_type
        wi_strkorr    = ps_request-h-trkorr
        iv_simulation = ' '
      IMPORTING
        we_trkorr     = lv_task
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS        = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      append_current_error_message ps_result.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    append_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 'S' 055
      lv_task sy-uname ps_request-h-trkorr space ps_result.
  ELSE.
    lv_task = pv_task.
  ENDIF.

* Enqueue and read task (enqueue first!). Do it also in case, a new task was created.
  CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'
    EXPORTING
      trkorr       = lv_task
    EXCEPTIONS
      foreign_lock = 1
      OTHERS       = 2.
  IF sy-subrc = 1.
    lv_user_msgv = sy-msgv1.
    append_error_message 'TK' 133
      lv_task lv_user_msgv space space ps_result.
    RETURN.
  ELSEIF sy-subrc <> 0.
    append_current_error_message ps_result.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* Read task
  ps_task-trkorr = lv_task.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'
    EXPORTING
      iv_read_e070  = 'X'
      iv_read_e07t  = 'X'
      iv_read_e070c = 'X'
    CHANGING
      cs_request    = ps_task
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS        = 1.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    append_current_error_message ps_result.
    dequeue_trkorr lv_task.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* Check basic attributes (errors are very unlikely -> generic message)
  IF ps_task-strkorr    <> ps_request-h-trkorr
  OR ps_task-as4user    <> sy-uname
  OR ( ps_task-trfunction <> pv_task_type
    AND ( ps_task-trfunction <> sctsc_type_unclass_task
      OR pv_task_type = sctsc_type_cust_task ) )
  OR ps_task-trstatus   <> sctsc_state_changeable.         "#EC USER_OK
    append_error_message 'CTS_WBO_API' 051
      ps_task-trkorr space space space ps_result.
    dequeue_trkorr lv_task.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* Change type of unclassified task
  IF ps_task-trfunction = sctsc_type_unclass_task.
    ps_task-trfunction = pv_task_type.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING ps_task TO ls_e070.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_MODIFY_COMM'
      EXPORTING
        wi_e070 = ls_e070
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS  = 99.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      append_current_error_message ps_result.
      dequeue_trkorr lv_task.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " check_or_create_task

*&      Form  append_result_and_messages
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Append result and messages from one sctsa_s_result structure
*       to another.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM append_result_and_messages
  USING    ps_source TYPE sctsa_s_result
  CHANGING ps_target TYPE sctsa_s_result.

  IF ps_source-result = sctsa_result_nok.
    ps_target-result = sctsa_result_nok.
  ENDIF.
  APPEND LINES OF ps_source-messages TO ps_target-messages.

ENDFORM.                    " append_result_and_messages

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  transform_ko200_to_e071
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Transform object table pt_ko200 (line type ko200)
*       into pt_e071 (line type e071)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM transform_ko200_to_e071
  USING    pt_ko200 TYPE tredt_objects
  CHANGING pt_e071 TYPE tr_objects.

  DATA:  ls_e071            TYPE e071,
         lr_ko200           TYPE REF TO ko200.

* The following code might be a little faster, but is vulnerable by
* side effects of future structure changes. So we don't use it here:
*  pt_e071 = pt_ko200.

  CLEAR pt_e071.
  LOOP  AT pt_ko200 REFERENCE INTO lr_ko200.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING lr_ko200->* TO ls_e071.
    APPEND ls_e071 TO pt_e071.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " transform_ko200_to_e071

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  check_new_code_active
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Check, if new code for object check and insert is active
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_new_code_active
  CHANGING pv_active TYPE trboolean.

  STATICS: sv_read TYPE trboolean VALUE space,
           sv_active TYPE trboolean VALUE space.
  DATA: ls_wbosyscntrl TYPE wbosyscntrl.

  IF sv_read = space.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM wbosyscntrl INTO ls_wbosyscntrl
      WHERE name = gc_old_oci_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_wbosyscntrl-value = gc_old_oci_value.
      sv_active = space.
    ELSE.
      sv_active = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    sv_read = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
  pv_active = sv_active.

ENDFORM.                    " check_new_code_active

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
***INCLUDE LCTS_WBO_API_IMPLF06 .
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  call_objects_check_and_insert
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Invoke TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT and do all necessary
*       parameter conversions
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM call_objects_check_and_insert
  USING
    ps_api_call TYPE sctsa_s_api_call
    pt_recording_entries TYPE cts_recording_entries
  CHANGING
    ps_check_result TYPE cts_check_result
    pt_messages TYPE cts_messages
    pt_usable_requests TYPE cts_requests
    ps_recording_request TYPE cts_request
    pt_object_locks TYPE cts_object_locks
    pt_ko200 TYPE tredt_objects
    pt_e071k TYPE tredt_keys.

  DATA: ls_message TYPE cts_message,
        lv_with_dialog TYPE trboolean,
        lt_obj_entries TYPE cts_obj_entries,
        ls_result TYPE sctsa_s_result,
        lt_objprops TYPE sctsa_t_object_props,
        lr_objprops TYPE REF TO sctsa_s_object_props,
        lv_msgid TYPE symsgid,
        lv_msgno TYPE symsgno,
        lv_msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
        lv_msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
        lv_msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
        lv_msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
        lt_headers TYPE trwbo_request_headers,
        lr_req TYPE REF TO trwbo_request,
        lt_e070a TYPE trwbo_t_e070a,
        lt_requests TYPE cts_requests,
        lr_request TYPE REF TO cts_request,
        lr_rtpair TYPE REF TO sctsa_s_rtpair,
        ls_object_lock TYPE cts_object_lock.

* Initializytion
  ps_check_result-result = sctsa_result_ok.
  IF ps_api_call-is_insert = 'X'.
    lv_with_dialog = 'D'.
  ELSE.
    lv_with_dialog = space.
  ENDIF.

* Convert recording entries
  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CONVERT_WBO_API_ENTRIES'
    EXPORTING
      it_recording_entries = pt_recording_entries
    IMPORTING
      et_obj_entries       = lt_obj_entries.

* Invoke TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT
  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT'
    EXPORTING
      iv_order                     = space
      iv_with_dialog               = lv_with_dialog
      iv_send_message              = space
      iv_no_show_option            = space
      iv_no_standard_editor        = space
      iv_externalps                = space
      iv_externalid                = space
      iv_no_ps                     = 'X'
      iv_read_activity_from_memory = 'X'
      iv_append_to_order           = space
      iv_insert_into_sbcsets       = space
      iv_old_call                  = space
      is_api_call                  = ps_api_call
      it_obj_entries               = lt_obj_entries
    IMPORTING
      es_result                    = ls_result
      et_objprops                  = lt_objprops
    CHANGING
      ct_ko200                     = pt_ko200
      ct_e071k                     = pt_e071k
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS                       = 1.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
* Should not happen.
    lv_msgid   = sy-msgid.
    lv_msgno   = sy-msgno.
    lv_msgv1   = sy-msgv1.
    lv_msgv2   = sy-msgv2.
    lv_msgv3   = sy-msgv3.
    lv_msgv4   = sy-msgv4.
* Reference parameters may contain something. Let's get, what we have.
    ps_check_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
    pt_messages = ls_result-messages.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
      EXPORTING
        msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
        msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
        msgno   = '062'
      IMPORTING
        message = ls_message.
    APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
      EXPORTING
        msgid   = lv_msgid
        msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
        msgno   = lv_msgno
        msgv1   = lv_msgv1
        msgv2   = lv_msgv2
        msgv3   = lv_msgv3
        msgv4   = lv_msgv4
      IMPORTING
        message = ls_message.
    APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
  ELSE.
    ps_check_result-result = ls_result-result.
    pt_messages = ls_result-messages.
  ENDIF.

* Convert export parameters
  IF ps_check_result-result = sctsa_result_ok.
    ps_check_result-recording = ls_result-recording.
    ps_check_result-existing_req_only = ls_result-existing_req_only.

* Convert recording request and task
    CLEAR: lt_headers, lt_e070a.
    IF ls_result-request-h-trkorr <> space.
      APPEND ls_result-request-h TO lt_headers.
      IF ls_result-task-trkorr <> space.
        APPEND ls_result-task TO lt_headers.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_result-repair-trkorr <> space.
        APPEND ls_result-repair TO lt_headers.
      ENDIF.
      PERFORM transform_requests
        USING
          lt_headers
          ls_result-request-attributes
        CHANGING
          lt_requests.
* There should be exactly one entry in lt_requests
      READ TABLE lt_requests INDEX 1 REFERENCE INTO lr_request.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ps_recording_request = lr_request->*.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

* Convert usable requests
    CLEAR: lt_headers, lt_e070a.
    LOOP AT ls_result-requests REFERENCE INTO lr_req.
      APPEND lr_req->h TO lt_headers.
      APPEND LINES OF lr_req->attributes TO lt_e070a.
    ENDLOOP.
    PERFORM transform_requests
      USING
        lt_headers
        lt_e070a
      CHANGING
        pt_usable_requests.
  ENDIF.

* Convert object locks (in case of check invocation or insert invocation with errors)
  IF ps_api_call-is_check = 'X'
  OR ps_check_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
    LOOP AT lt_objprops REFERENCE INTO lr_objprops.
      CLEAR: lt_headers, lt_e070a.
      LOOP AT lr_objprops->locks REFERENCE INTO lr_rtpair.
        IF lr_rtpair->request-h-trkorr <> space.
          APPEND lr_rtpair->request-h TO lt_headers.
          APPEND LINES OF lr_rtpair->request-attributes TO lt_e070a.
          IF lr_rtpair->task-trkorr <> space.
            APPEND lr_rtpair->task TO lt_headers.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
* Since we have one pair entry per TLOCK entry, requests (and even tasks)
* may be contained several times. Sort and remove duplicates.
      SORT lt_headers BY trkorr.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_headers COMPARING trkorr.
      SORT lt_e070a BY trkorr pos.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_e070a COMPARING trkorr pos.
      PERFORM transform_requests
        USING
          lt_headers
          lt_e070a
        CHANGING
          lt_requests.
      CLEAR ls_object_lock.
      ls_object_lock-object_key = lr_objprops->key.
      LOOP AT lt_requests REFERENCE INTO lr_request.
        ls_object_lock-lock_holder = lr_request->*.
        APPEND ls_object_lock TO pt_object_locks.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " call_objects_check_and_insert
